sentences.text: Suomen Vesistökunnostus Oy is a company registered on 2025-02-03 under the industry code 42910, construction of water projects.
First sales are recorded on 2025-02-01, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2025-02-19.
A public contract record dated 2026-07-20 shows EUR 278 600, and the radar reads it as a buyer purchasing in an operational setting, which sets the technology level at 7.
For the fund the memo points to a partner introduction, and the contract notice is the first thing to open to see who the buyer is.
